rollout.notes: First-order single-backtrace semi-Lagrangian advection, as used in training and in the trainer's evaluation. The evaluation rollout clamps and renormalises total mass every step; the training rollout with --peak-norm skipped the renormalisation.

data.source: 62 glyphs (0-9, A-Z, a-z) x 22 DejaVu font faces
data.notes: Glyphs rendered at 256, extruded (depth 0.3*max(H,W)), init-fill 0.7, Gaussian blur sigma 0.7 voxel, trilinearly resized to total mass 8000 (margin 0.9), clipped to [0,1]. Built with voxelize_font_3d.py. DejaVu fonts are freely redistributable.

training.init: continuation (not released intermediates): exp52 fresh 2-GPU run (lambda_ke 0.1, lambda_mu 0.003, lr 1e-4, init-scale 10; stopped at ~step 3400, best = step 3000) -> exp53 (3000 steps from exp52 best, 1 GPU, lambda_ke 0, lambda_mu 0.003, lr 1e-4; best = final = step 3000) -> this run (1500 steps from exp53 best). --init-from loads all parameters except trunc_mask.
training.provenance: original launch script scripts/_run_exp68_font_continue_mu00025.sh; training log exp68_font_continue_mu00025_1gpu.log
training.args_note: Flags of the original launch command (original entry point: fluidot_improved.train_3d). `--save-dir` is omitted; absolute data paths of the original run are rewritten relative to the repository root (data/...). `advection` is new in the release package and made explicit here; the original code hard-wired this scheme.
training.command: python -m viot.train_3d --resolution 128 --sampler shapenet --data-path-src data/font_3d_volresize_n8000_128.pt --data-path-tgt data/font_3d_volresize_n8000_128.pt --batch-size 6 --lr 5e-5 --n-steps 1500 --n-rollout 10 --n-test 10 --n-infer-steps 50 --k-max 0.25 --fno-width 32 --fno-modes 16 --fno-layers 6 --bb-visc-only --lambda-ke 0.0 --lambda-mu 0.0025 --lambda-mu-warmup 0 --lambda-terminal 10.0 --amp --checkpoint --log-every 100 --no-scheduler --grad-clip 1.0 --raw-sampler --peak-norm --init-from results_spectral_3d/exp53_font_continue_ke0_1gpu/spectral_bb_visc_3d_model_best.pt --advection semi_lagrangian
training.original_args_note: Relative to the original launch command: --data-path-src .data/font_3d_volresize_n8000_128.pt -> data/font_3d_volresize_n8000_128.pt; --data-path-tgt .data/font_3d_volresize_n8000_128.pt -> data/font_3d_volresize_n8000_128.pt. Data files are expected under data/ (see scripts/data/README.md).

checkpoint.selection: model_best: lowest single-training-batch terminal loss among the checkpoints saved every 1000 steps (not a validation criterion)
checkpoint.state_dict_note: keys and tensors identical to the original .pt state_dict, including the trunc_mask buffer

end_of_training_eval_final_weights.note: terminal L2 printed by the trainer's end-of-training evaluation (seed 42) on the final weights of this run, not on this checkpoint; useful as a reference when retraining
